item: Download the whole corpus's citation graph from Explore > Links (Lane M, R684)
summary: GET /api/links/export.graphml and /export.json had no button. The Links panel now ends with GraphML and JSON downloads (same-origin, no network call) and a visible caveat that the file is the whole corpus, not the analysis on screen, capped at the 2,000 most-cited sites and at most 2,000 of their articles; links counted, never a credibility score. 3 strings in 12 languages. Feature ceiling down by 2.
